title: Neural Network Topology Replication
description: Given a reference node of a connected undirected graph representing a neural network schema where each node contains a unique integer identifier and a list of its connected neighbor nodes, return a deep copy (clone) of the network. Each node in the graph must contain a value equal to its clone's value and a exact replica of its neighbor list structure.
constraints: The number of nodes in the graph is in the range [0, 100].
Node.val is unique for each node.
There are no repeated edges and no self-loops.
The graph is connected and can be accessed via the given node.
output_format: A reference to the cloned Node.

examples.explanation: There are 4 nodes in the graph. Node 1 is connected to nodes 2 and 4. Node 2 is connected to nodes 1 and 3. And so on.
Note that the input contains an empty graph with a single node where val = 1 and it has no neighbors.
An empty graph given as input returns an empty graph.
